title: Dependent care FSA - federal basics
facts: An employer dependent care assistance program can allow eligible employees to pay qualifying dependent-care expenses with tax-advantaged benefits, subject to federal limits and plan terms.
Dependent-care FSA rules are different from health FSA rules and the accounts should not be treated interchangeably.
Using dependent-care benefits can affect the expenses available for the Child and Dependent Care Credit, preventing double tax benefits for the same expense.
Annual federal exclusion limits and plan-specific election rules should be checked for the applicable tax year.
